4.2.3 History and Archeology
The Applicant has funded an archeological survey of the proposed reservoir area. The survey, conducted by John D. Combes, Institute of Archeology and Anthropology, University of South Carolina, concluded that no historical of prehistorical sites would be jeopardized by the Bad Creek Project. The report recommended, however, that the Institute be kept abreast of construction activities and be informed should clearing operations uncover any archeological sites. The Applicant has accepted the recommendations.
This archeological survey did not include the proposed transmission line corridor. However, Applicant has stated that a survey would be conducted along the route where road construction and tower placement would occur.
